create_HangmanGame: create a HangmanGame instance with a custom word list file and max incorrect guesses parameter
create_HangmanState: create a HangmanState from a HangmanGame to start a new game with a specific or random word
run_HangmanObserver: run a HangmanObserver to get observation strings and tensors from game state for a player
load_word_list: load a word list from a file and validate each word against minimum length and valid letter rules
register_HangmanGame: register the HangmanGame with OpenSpiel pyspiel library for use as python_hangman game
